metric_definitions.usage: Allowlisted actual provider counters across every summary and ordinary attempt; cached_tokens is a subset of input_tokens for this provider. Missing counters remain unavailable.
metric_definitions.summary_calls: Prepared private summary operations; HTTP counts and per-operation attempts report retries separately.
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: Session opening, two submissions and strict reopen; excludes fixture preparation.
metric_definitions.exact_facts: Strict parsed JSON equality with deterministic synthetic ground truth; no judge or relaxed parsing.
metric_definitions.elision: Projection before admission: successful read bodies above 2048 characters, except last two complete cycles; trigger at 60% estimated input allowance. Original canonical history still supplies summary input.

analysis: Rescored each original submission from its own saved user boundary; aggregates computed by the current driver. Live calls, histories, timing and token counters were not rerun or modified.
